_comment: The offer block. Everything money-related is OFF until Karin types the numbers herself. show_prices=false → cards say 'הצעה מותאמת אחרי שיחת האפיון'. pilot.slots/discount null → shown without numbers. guarantee.show=false → no guarantee box. payment_url empty → no payment button.
